options.content:
EVALUATOR VIEW
Can the deployed AIDRA run produce auditable D3/D4 evidence?
This dashboard is intentionally evidence-first: live operational status, GEOINT output, traceability completeness, hardware-profile budget fit, model registry and known validation gaps. Green means the deployed database contains the evidence; yellow/red means the evaluator should ask for the referenced offline artefact or a new run.
Runs created before 2026-05-11 are hidden so the KPIs reflect the post-fix build (after the Tip & Cue zone-mapping incident, migrations 013/014). The failed rows are kept in the database for traceability; log in to Grafana to query the full history.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM execution_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND status = 'success'
  AND (LEFT('$model', 1) = '$' OR '$model' = 'all' OR model_name = '$model')
  AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR constraint_profile = '$profile')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM detections d
JOIN execution_log e ON e.id = d.execution_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
  AND e.created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND e.status = 'success'
  AND d.quality_verdict = 'valid_sea_target'
  AND (LEFT('$model', 1) = '$' OR '$model' = 'all' OR e.model_name = '$model')
  AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR e.constraint_profile = '$profile')

panels.title: Traceability completeness
panels.description: Share of successful runs in the selected range that carry every provenance field: image, model, output and input-params hashes plus the commit SHA (I-TRACE-1, I-TRACE-4). Placeholders such as 'pending' count as missing. 'No data' means no successful run in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.image_hash, '') NOT IN ('', 'pending', 'unknown')
    AND COALESCE(e.model_hash, '') NOT IN ('', 'pending', 'unknown')
    AND COALESCE(e.output_hash, '') NOT IN ('', 'pending', 'unknown')
    AND COALESCE(e.input_params_hash, '') NOT IN ('', 'pending', 'unknown')
    AND COALESCE(e.commit_sha, '') NOT IN ('', 'pending', 'unknown')
THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value
FROM execution_log e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
  AND e.created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND e.status = 'success'
  AND (LEFT('$model', 1) = '$' OR '$model' = 'all' OR e.model_name = '$model')
  AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR e.constraint_profile = '$profile')

panels.title: Error rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status IN ('error', 'failed'))::float
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status NOT IN ('skipped', 'pending', 'running')), 0) AS value
FROM execution_log e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
  AND e.created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND (LEFT('$model', 1) = '$' OR '$model' = 'all' OR e.model_name = '$model')
  AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR e.constraint_profile = '$profile')

panels.description: Runs in the selected range that ended in 'error' or 'failed', over attempted runs. 'skipped' runs (nothing new to process) are not attempts and are excluded. 'No data' means no run was attempted in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(created_at)) * 1000 AS value
FROM execution_log
WHERE created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND status = 'success'
  AND (LEFT('$model', 1) = '$' OR '$model' = 'all' OR model_name = '$model')
  AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR constraint_profile = '$profile')

panels.title: D3 traceability chain - most recent successful runs
panels.description: Every row should be enough to reproduce lineage: input image, model, output, settings and git commit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  created_at AS run_at,
  LEFT(id::text, 8) AS run_id,
  model_name,
  model_version,
  constraint_profile AS profile,
  LEFT(image_hash, 12) AS image_sha,
  LEFT(model_hash, 12) AS model_sha,
  LEFT(output_hash, 12) AS output_sha,
  LEFT(input_params_hash, 12) AS settings_sha,
  LEFT(commit_sha, 10) AS commit,
  num_detections,
  ROUND((inference_ms / 60000.0)::numeric, 1) AS inference_min
FROM execution_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND status = 'success'
  AND (LEFT('$model', 1) = '$' OR '$model' = 'all' OR model_name = '$model')
  AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR constraint_profile = '$profile')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Hardware-profile budget audit · same scene, FP32
panels.description: Same rule as the Constraint Profiles dashboard: latest attempt per profile on the most recent scene attempted under all five profiles (FP32 baseline). Not limited to the selected time range: profile sweeps are run on demand. FAIL_RAM_ABORTED = stopped by the memory guard; FAIL_RAM_OVER_BUDGET = completed over budget before the guard existed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH budgets(profile, cpu_budget_cores, ram_budget_mb) AS (
    VALUES
        ('ground', 4.0, 24576),
        ('sat-high', 2.0, 4096),
        ('sat-mid', 1.0, 2048),
        ('sat-low', 0.5, 1024),
        ('sat-extreme', 0.25, 512)
), scoped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM execution_log
    WHERE trigger_type <> 'cue'
        AND status IN ('success', 'error', 'failed')
        AND image_hash <> 'pending'
        AND (notes IS NULL OR notes NOT LIKE '%methodology:%')
        -- public dashboards do not interpolate variables: default to the FP32 baseline
        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(compression_technique, ''), 'none')
            = 'none'
), scene AS (
    -- same scene, same model: the most recent scene attempted under all five profiles
    SELECT image_hash
    FROM scoped
    GROUP BY image_hash
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT constraint_profile) = 5
    ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC
    LIMIT 1
), latest AS (
    -- the latest attempt per profile on that scene
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (constraint_profile)
        constraint_profile AS profile,
        status,
        created_at,
        image_title,
        inference_ms,
        cpu_usage_pct,
        num_detections,
        avg_confidence,
        error_message,
        COALESCE(peak_ram_mb, (substring(error_message from 'peak RSS ([0-9.]+) MB'))::float) AS peak_mb
    FROM scoped
    WHERE image_hash = (SELECT image_hash FROM scene)
    ORDER BY constraint_profile, created_at DESC
)
SELECT
    b.profile,
    CASE
        WHEN l.profile IS NULL THEN 'NO DATA'
        WHEN l.status <> 'success' AND l.error_message LIKE '%memory budget exceeded%' THEN 'FAIL_RAM_ABORTED'
        WHEN l.status <> 'success' THEN 'FAIL_RUN'
        WHEN l.peak_mb > b.ram_budget_mb THEN 'FAIL_RAM_OVER_BUDGET'
        WHEN (l.cpu_usage_pct / 100.0) > (b.cpu_budget_cores * 1.10) THEN 'WARN_CPU'
        ELSE 'PASS'
    END AS budget_verdict,
    l.status AS run_status,
    b.ram_budget_mb,
    ROUND(l.peak_mb::numeric, 0) AS peak_ram_mb,
    ROUND((l.peak_mb / NULLIF(b.ram_budget_mb, 0))::numeric, 2) AS ram_budget_ratio,
    b.cpu_budget_cores,
    ROUND((l.cpu_usage_pct / 100.0)::numeric, 2) AS observed_cores,
    ROUND((l.inference_ms / 60000.0)::numeric, 1) AS latency_min,
    l.num_detections AS detections,
    ROUND(l.avg_confidence::numeric, 3) AS avg_confidence,
    l.created_at AS run_at,
    l.image_title AS scene
FROM budgets b
LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.profile = b.profile
ORDER BY CASE b.profile
    WHEN 'ground' THEN 1
    WHEN 'sat-high' THEN 2
    WHEN 'sat-mid' THEN 3
    WHEN 'sat-low' THEN 4
    WHEN 'sat-extreme' THEN 5
END

panels.title: Model and compression evidence gaps · full-scene runs
panels.description: Execution data is live. Accuracy metrics mAP/Pd/FAR are currently documented in model cards/validation artefacts, not persisted in execution_log. Validation metrics are those of the same model, version and compression technique (average over its validation runs); the paired comparison against FP32 is in the Compression Benchmarks dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  model_name,
  model_version,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(compression_technique, ''), 'none') AS compression,
  ROUND(AVG(model_size_mb)::numeric, 1) AS size_mb,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS success_runs,
  ROUND((AVG(inference_ms) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / 60000.0)::numeric, 1) AS avg_latency_min,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_confidence) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success')::numeric, 3) AS avg_confidence,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(map_at_iou)::numeric, 4) FROM validation_runs v WHERE v.model_name = execution_log.model_name AND v.model_version = execution_log.model_version AND COALESCE(NULLIF(v.compression_technique,''),'none') = COALESCE(NULLIF(execution_log.compression_technique,''),'none')) AS map_at_iou,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(pd_recall)::numeric, 4) FROM validation_runs v WHERE v.model_name = execution_log.model_name AND v.model_version = execution_log.model_version AND COALESCE(NULLIF(v.compression_technique,''),'none') = COALESCE(NULLIF(execution_log.compression_technique,''),'none')) AS pd_recall,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(far_per_km2)::numeric, 4) FROM validation_runs v WHERE v.model_name = execution_log.model_name AND v.model_version = execution_log.model_version AND COALESCE(NULLIF(v.compression_technique,''),'none') = COALESCE(NULLIF(execution_log.compression_technique,''),'none')) AS far_per_km2,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM validation_runs v WHERE v.model_name = execution_log.model_name AND v.model_version = execution_log.model_version AND COALESCE(NULLIF(v.compression_technique,''),'none') = COALESCE(NULLIF(execution_log.compression_technique,''),'none')) > 0 THEN 'validated' ELSE 'NEEDS_DB_METRIC: mAP/Pd/FAR' END AS accuracy_evidence
FROM execution_log
WHERE trigger_type <> 'cue' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND (LEFT('$model', 1) = '$' OR '$model' = 'all' OR model_name = '$model')
  AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR constraint_profile = '$profile')
GROUP BY model_name, model_version, compression_technique
ORDER BY model_name, compression

panels.title: GEOINT scene coverage and quality flags
panels.description: Separates actionable sea detections from raw CFAR/Yolo output, land hits and cluster anomalies.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  e.image_title AS scene,
  MIN(e.image_sensing_date) AS sensed_at,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS runs,
  COUNT(d.id) AS raw_detections,
  COUNT(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.quality_verdict = 'valid_sea_target') AS valid_sea_targets,
  COUNT(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.quality_verdict = 'candidate') AS cfar_candidates,
  COUNT(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.quality_verdict = 'coastal_candidate') AS coastal_candidates,
  COUNT(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.quality_verdict = 'land_artifact') AS land_artifacts,
  COUNT(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.quality_verdict = 'cluster_artifact') AS cluster_artifacts,
  COUNT(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.quality_verdict = 'outside_footprint') AS outside_footprint,
  ROUND(AVG(d.confidence) FILTER (WHERE d.quality_verdict = 'valid_sea_target')::numeric, 3) AS valid_avg_confidence
FROM execution_log e
LEFT JOIN detections d ON d.execution_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
  AND e.created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND e.status = 'success'
  AND (LEFT('$model', 1) = '$' OR '$model' = 'all' OR e.model_name = '$model')
  AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR e.constraint_profile = '$profile')
GROUP BY e.image_title
ORDER BY sensed_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 12
